description: Shrink a PDF by re-rendering every page as a JPEG image (best for scans and photo-heavy files). Presets like the website: email (96 DPI, quality 55), balanced (144 DPI, 72), high (220 DPI, 85); or set dpi/quality yourself; optional grayscale. The result loses selectable text, links and form fields. Reports before/after size and a verdict ("bigger" means keep the original: the PDF was already efficient). Web version: https://s3eidat.github.io/pdf-compress/

file.description: The PDF: a local file path (absolute, or relative to the server's --root) or base64 data (raw or a data: URI).

output.description: Where to write the result: a file path, or a folder ending in "/". Default: the server output folder (a temp folder unless --out-dir is set).

password.description: Password, if the PDF is protected.

returnBase64.description: Also return the output as base64 in the result (only for small files). Default false.

name: pdf_compress
title: Compress PDF
